name: Gatik autonomous box truck
def: Retrofitted box truck that drives fixed middle mile freight routes between warehouses and stores, running driverless on some routes in the United States.
body: Gatik takes production class box trucks and fits them with a retrofit autonomy kit of lidar, radar, cameras and compute. The trucks run short repeatable middle mile routes between distribution centres, dark stores and retail outlets, which lets the company validate a fixed operating domain closely. Some routes run fully driverless with no person in the cab, while others keep a safety driver. Customers include grocery and consumer goods shippers in the United States and Canada.
facts: Made fully driverless commercial box truck deliveries for Walmart in Bentonville, Arkansas, from 2021
Runs middle mile freight for Sam's Club and hauls for Georgia-Pacific through KBX
Reported hundreds of additional trucks planned for United States roads in 2026
specs: Autonomy kit retrofitted to medium duty commercial box trucks
Level 4 autonomy constrained to fixed, pre validated middle mile routes with remote monitoring
